versions.changelog:
Initial release of agent-browser-skip.

- Provides a Rust-based, fast headless browser automation CLI with Node.js fallback.
- Enables AI agents to navigate, interact, fill forms, extract data, take snapshots, record video, and more using structured commands.
- Supports a wide range of actions: navigation, DOM interaction, screenshots, PDF exports, network interception, state management, and semantic selectors.
- Includes full CLI documentation and quick start instructions.
